hold_text: Touches the daily-DD switch's RiskManager / PropRiskManager equity-read path (which readings may fold). The refusal rule and the limits are unchanged. Held for the manager to merge under the operator's DAILY-DD-SWITCH directive (2026-10-09).
why: ib_live (armed, mode dry_run) can never be read by design, so it records dry_run_not_read with no red flag. breakout_2 (phone-flow prop) was could_not_look after every reset because its only source is the phone; a pre-day snapshot is now folded as carried_quiescent (never ok) while no fill, open position or live ticket exists since it. Also fixes a timestamp jitter that stopped the unreadable streak advancing on prop accounts.
